title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — Mock Exam #6

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Light? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Light.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Light.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Light.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Light.

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Heat.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Matter? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Matter.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Matter.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Matter.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Matter.

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
